title: Span mirror and consistency checker for cross-backend trace reads
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: We have intermittent discrepancies between traces returned from different storage backends (Tempo vs Jaeger-compatible stores). Root causes range from ingestion normalization differences, partial write failures, to retention/archival timing. This ticket proposes a lightweight span-mirroring and consistency-checker pipeline that reads from the ingest stream and from both backend query APIs to detect missing spans, attribute drift, timestamp skew, and sampling divergence. Goals: 1) Surface a per-tenant and global discrepancy metric (fraction of traces/spans with disagreement) and expose it to Grafana. 2) Provide an automated daily reconciliation report and an on-demand API for a given trace ID to show side-by-side span diffs. 3) Add tracing hooks that annotate traces with a mirror-check span when a reconciliation run touches them, to help correlate production incidents. Non-goals: this ticket will not attempt automatic repair of persisted spans or modify retention policies. Design summary: - A small reconciler service consumes a copy of the OTLP/span ingest stream (via Kafka topic mirror) and also periodically queries both backends for recently ingested trace IDs. - For each trace ID of interest the reconciler pulls spans from both backends and runs a deterministic comparison pipeline: span presence, attribute set intersection/union, service/name match, and timestamp delta histogram. - Reconciler emits Prometheus metrics: tracer_mirror_checked_total, tracer_mirror_mismatch_total, tracer_mirror_skew_seconds_histogram, tracer_mirror_attribute_delta_total and labels for tenant, env, backend_pair. - A sidecar tracing hook is added to the query gateway: when a trace is fetched by the gateway and the trace ID is within the reconciler sampling windows, annotate the outgoing trace with a small child span that records which backend(s) served the query and the reconciliation result (if available). - UI: Grafana dashboard showing mismatch rate by tenant, time-series of skew percentiles, top 10 attribute differences, and a drill-down panel to call the on-demand diff API. Trade-offs and considerations: - Performance: querying both backends for every trace is expensive. We will limit full comparisons to a sampled subset (default 1% of traces) and high-risk paths (errors/latency spikes). - Privacy & PII: reconciliation runs must respect tenant redaction rules; any sensitive attributes are masked before comparison. - Consistency vs. Freshness: allow configurable staleness window (e.g., only compare traces older than 30s) to avoid false positives due to write propagation. - Failure modes: reconciler isolation prevents retries from affecting ingest pipeline; mismatches are stored in a lightweight windowed store for 7 days. Acceptance criteria: - Reconciler service deployed to staging and reading mirrored ingest for at least 24h without impacting primary pipeline. - Grafana dashboard with the 4 required panels and alert rule firing on mismatch rate > 0.5% sustained for 10 minutes. - On-demand diff API: returns side-by-side span lists for a trace ID within 2s median response for recent traces. - A canary rollout limiting checks to 1% of traces, with rollout toggle in the Console. Implementation plan: 1) Prototype comparator library in go/tracing/comparator with unit tests and small golden samples. 2) Build reconciler service that subscribes to the mirror topic and to the backend query clients. 3) Integrate sidecar hook in query gateway with feature flag. 4) Add Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboard JSON in the observability repo. 5) Run staging baseline, iterate on sampling heuristics, then ramp to prod 5% -> 20% -> 100% for non-sensitive tenants. Testing and rollout: - Unit tests for comparator and attribute normalization (golden fixtures included). - E2E in staging: run reconciler for 48h and validate mismatch rates against synthetic injection tests. - Safety: add circuit breaker to reconciler to pause if it sees > 5% query errors against backends. Links and artifacts: - Design doc: https://confluence.internal.redwood/obs/span-mirror-design (draft) - Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/8123 - Grafana dashboard JSON: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1R-ObsDashboards - Reconciler container image tag (staging): ghcr.io/redwood/reconciler:staging-20260312 Rollout and monitoring: - Initial canary: 1% traces in staging, 1% in prod for internal tenants only. - SLOs for reconciler: CPU < 0.5 core per 1000 checks/sec average, memory < 512MB for replicated instances. - Alerts: mismatch-rate-high, reconciler-query-errors, reconciler-cpu-pressure Post-deployment follow-ups: - If mismatch causes > 0.2% for high-traffic tenant, open a follow-up bug to trace ingestion path and add automated span-capture tests. - Consider optional downstream repair agent in a later ticket.
